note: No old Notion page existed for this child. These are claims made by the root and by siblings that this page owns or depends on, with how they were reconciled (checked 2026-10-05).

items.claim: Root and programming_model: NVIDIA CUDA Graphs post, 2.9 us kernel, 9.6 us per kernel with sync, 3.4 us with graphs (V100, 2019)
items.verdict: verified (Gray, Sep 5 2019); the post also gives 3.8 us without per-kernel sync and ~400 us to create and instantiate; carried in section 3 and the launch animation

items.claim: Root 20_read_b: work in one stream runs in order; different streams may overlap (copies, NCCL with backward); events order streams and time the GPU
items.verdict: consistent; expanded in sections 1, 2, 6 with the caveat that may-overlap is not will-overlap

items.claim: Root coverage.md: pinned-memory pipeline left to child
items.verdict: carried: section 2 (s1_pipeline.cu compiled, pipeline model and interactive chart)

items.claim: Root library table: NCCL collectives as an API you call on a stream
programming_model section 8: M1 launch-and-wait 179.5 us vs 5.8 us queued (MLX)
items.verdict: consistent with this page's direct Metal measurement (wait each 179.9 us, queued 21.9 us through PyObjC without MLX's batching); linked, not repeated

items.claim: programming_model section 7: pinned memory, cudaMemcpyAsync overlaps only from pinned memory
items.verdict: consistent; section 2 adds copy engines and the non_blocking D2H hazard

items.claim: Interconnects page: PCIe 5.0 63 GB/s each way; NCCL_DEBUG=INFO shows the transport; busbw definitions; Together AI ~92% acceptance target
Common claim: conditional nodes arrived in CUDA 12.3
items.verdict: corrected: IF and WHILE in CUDA 12.4, ELSE and SWITCH in 12.8 (NVIDIA blog May 10 2024, updated Feb 3 2025)

items.claim: Common claim: DeepEP is built on NVSHMEM
items.verdict: out of date: DeepEP V2 uses an NCCL Gin backend and V2.5 removed the NVSHMEM backend (README, Sep 30 2026)

items.claim: Common usage: NCCL_BLOCKING_WAIT / NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING are NCCL variables
items.verdict: corrected: they are PyTorch's (now TORCH_NCCL_*); neither string is in libnccl 2.31.2, checked with strings
